notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Connects to MySQL with root and no password (-h host, -u root, no -p flag or empty -p). MySQL empty root password is a critical misconfiguration — full database access without authentication.

=== CHAINING ===
nmap mysql* NSE confirms empty password → connect as root → show databases → access mysql.user table for password hashes → read sensitive application data → check secure_file_priv for file read/write.

=== FILE READ ===
If secure_file_priv is empty: LOAD DATA INFILE '/etc/passwd' INTO TABLE t → file read as the mysql process user. Combined with web shell write → full compromise.

=== FALSE POSITIVE CAUTION ===
Nmap mysql-empty-password NSE may return false positives. Always manually verify with direct mysql client connection before treating as confirmed.
